detail.longDescription: DeepSeek's free, open-source agent app Harness hit 1.54 million daily users on November 4, less than three months after launch. It burns about 92 trillion tokens a day. Around 35,000 community plugins exist, and about 60% of users have built or installed at least one. The catch, in its own README: it hasn't passed a security audit yet. How many plugins have you installed so far? # DeepSeek # AIAgents # OpenSource
